Hi Noah,

Glad that works for you. Nothing else to do on your side beyond the drop-off.

Your replacement is set up and reserved: a Hammer Miner BC04 (6 TH/s), at no cost to you. It's held on our side with your return reference Shop····, and it ships out the moment your NerdQaxe++ is checked in at our Chattanooga warehouse. You'll get tracking by email when it leaves us.

Just write Shop···· on the outside of the box, use the prepaid UPS label ((number hidden)), and keep the Mean Well supply. I'll let you know here once the unit lands with us.

It was a pleasure helping you with this. If you were happy with how we handled it, a short review on Trustpilot would mean a lot: https://www.trustpilot.com/review/heliumdeploy.com

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
